posts.name: Sreejak Bhattacharjee
posts.cooked:
Hey I have a query it would be really helpful if someone could help me out, so I have failed to clear the OPPE this term and as per the grading document I will have the chance to clear just the OPPE next term. So the question is what are the procedures I need to follow next so that I have to just reappear for the OPPE and not the whole course.

It would be really great if someone could guide me through the procedure.

Thank you

Sreejak Bhattacharjee

posts.name: Amitava Bhattacherjee
posts.cooked: While selecting courses In the next course registration window you’ll get two options, one to repeat the entire SC course and another to just repeat the OPPE

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked: Also, note please do submit BPTs next term (as per the deadline) to make yourself eligible for OPPE.

posts.name: Anirudh Natarajan Raja
posts.cooked: Can anyone suggest any good practice material to study for the OPPEs(other than ppa, grpa, bpt and nppe)? I really want to see different types of questions so that I can crack the OPPE next term

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked: Practicing is the key. You can practice on various platforms such as Hackerank but these platform will have questions of varying difficulty level and not similar to OPPE. It would be best if you practice on terminal with scripts of your own. Take a dataset of your choice try to extract values, do mathematical operations and build your own scripts such as scripts which delete empty files, etc. Course vm also has various questions on grep, awk, sed, etc. @AnirudhNatarajanRaja
